payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped opt-in refresh/access-token split. New auth_refresh_tokens table (migration 0018, SQLite+PG), RefreshTokenStore (store.refreshTokens), identityProviders.refresh config (accessTokenTtlSeconds/refreshTokenTtlSeconds/rotateOnRefresh). Sign-ins mint short access session + long refresh token; POST /auth/refresh exchanges+rotates, POST /auth/refresh/revoke revokes. Apple-revoke + password-reset also revoke refresh tokens. Fully backward compatible (routes 404 when unconfigured). typecheck clean; server vitest 826 passed (was 818) + new tests/refresh-tokens.test.ts (8 tests).
